Last year, Zach Cregger followed up on his horror hit Barbarian with the huge success Weapons, which made almost $300 million at the box office alongside scoring impressive reviews from critics. Last weekend, Cregger returned to the big screen with an adaptation that defied the poor reputation of its predecessors and completed a near-perfect trilogy of horror films for the director.

Resident Evil's start to box office life has been notably impressive, almost outgrossing the lifetime hauls of two of the franchise's other film entries in just one weekend. The film has also earned a near-perfect critical reception, scoring a 95% average rating on Rotten Tomatoes. In a year of high-profile horror films stealing cinematic headlines, Resident Evil has managed to stand out. But other 2026 gems, perhaps because of the genre's success this year, have fallen cruelly under the radar.

One such film to fall under the radar is Over Your Dead Body, an R-rated horror remake of The Trip, the 2021 Norwegian psychological thriller starring Noomi Rapace. The film stars an unhappily married couple — Jason Segel and Samara Weaving — as they venture to a secluded cabin on a faux vacation, with hidden plans to kill each other. However, some escaped convicts hiding in the house ruin their murderous schemes. Although the film had a limited theatrical release in the U.S., Over Your Dead Body is known for its streaming success, with the film recently surpassing the 50-day mark on the AMC+ top ten.
